# Legacy depth save fixtures

Generated with unmodified commit `c41b951` before removing runtime depth layers. Each is a 16×12 world, world seed 53 / simulation seed 17, with a bridge at (3,4), a cave at (4,4), 60 ticks of history, and the legacy depth overlay/bridge tool selected. The two files exercise archive versions 1 and 2.

The flat-world loader must keep both passages traversable as plains, clear depth settings/history, and continue simulation without retaining elevation/habitat/moisture runtime layers.
